provider: CUHK Quantitative Finance Programme 2025-26 Study Scheme
academicYear: Applicable to students admitted in 2025-26; reviewed on 2026-07-30
note: The official 2025-26 Study Scheme closes a 72-unit Major: 9 Faculty Package units, 3 Faculty Co-curricular units, 27 Required units and 33 Elective units. The PDF publishes 135 unique course-list rows with code, title and units; MATH1530 is additionally named as a conditional prerequisite for specified entrants and its title and 3 units are confirmed by the linked official Mathematics course page. The Elective requirement has at least 9 Quantitative Methods units, at least 12 Business units including at least 6 FINA units and at most six one-unit courses, and at least 12 Core-pool units. Nine Core-pool courses are explicitly marked as Capstone courses. The alternative Required paths, conditional MATH1530 waiver, eligible second-major/minor substitution for the Quantitative Methods area, Co-operative Education substitution for FINA4390, prerequisites and annual offering require manual review. This 136-course official list is intentionally browse-only and must not produce a graduation completion percentage.
